verses.text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

segments.text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

verses.text: Dominion and fear are with him; He maketh peace in his high places.

segments.text: Dominion and fear are with him;

verses.text: Is there any number of his armies? And upon whom doth not his light arise?

segments.text: Is there any number of his armies?

verses.text: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

segments.text: How then can man be just with God?
Or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

verses.text: Behold, even the moon hath no brightness, And the stars are not pure in his sight:

And the stars are not pure in his sight:

verses.text: How much less man, that is a worm! And the son of man, that is a worm!
